messages:
mina: Quick idea 1 - create a small "sample bank" in the console that shows representative payloads + an estimated "embed-cost-score" so customers understand preflight results before iterating.

jordan: Love it. We get a lot of customers pasting random arrays and then hitting 413s. A catalog of examples would lower support load.

kai: How are we calculating "embed-cost-score"? we should avoid another magic number. Propose: score = (dims * seq_factor) + (bytes/2048). normalize to 0..100 and round.

mina: Good call. We can expose both the raw estimate and the normalized score. Raw estimate for routing/quota math, score for UX.

jordan: Console UX: show three tabs in the sample bank: "short", "long-doc", "multi-dim". Each row: sample name, payload snippet, estimated_units, score, and a "simulate in my tenant" button.

telemetry-svc: Metric proposal: emit preflight.raw_units, preflight.normalized_score, split.suggested_count, split.actual_count, preflight.decision. Add tenant_feature_flag tag.

kai: For client-side behavior we should publish a stable header name: X-Embed-Preflight-Score and X-Embed-Estimate. Also an error code when upload is rejected: EMBED_OVERSIZED. JS/py SDKs can treat that as retry-with-split.

mina: Example client snippet for SDK authors: 
```
// sdk pseudo
const resp = await fetch('/v1/embeddings/preflight', { method: 'POST', body: payload })
// server returns { estimate: 4.2, score: 65, suggestions: [ { split: 2, reason: 'dim_limit' } ] }
if (resp.estimate > tenantThreshold) showSoftWarning();
```

jordan: Runtime note: preflight must be cheap and deterministic. No heavy parsing. If we need exact math we do post-ingress analysis with split planner.

telemetry-svc: Also recommend a small histogram per-tenant: preflight.estimate vs routed.actual_units, with 95p diff alert.

kai: Rollout plan: console flag "sample-bank" false by default. Stage: internal-only -> opt-in tenants -> 10% traffic canary for 48h -> 50% for 24h -> GA. We'll surface rollout state in console.

console-bot: Deploy triggered: embed-preflight-samplebank v1 -> canary(10%) by kai

mina: Support copy: include a link in the warning modal: "How to split embeddings" with examples and an auto-splitter snippet.

jordan: One more ops ask: ensure preflight metrics don't count against billing. Mark them as preflight:true in the meter.

telemetry-svc: acked. I'll add preflight:true tag and ensure billing pipeline ignores those. Adding a nightly job to backfill sample bank popularity.

mina: OK - sync tomorrow 9:30 to finalize metric names and the sample bank initial rows.
